Comparison Results:
The left side shows the auto-generated scale using CSS color-mix. The right side shows your custom hand-picked colors.

Notice how the auto-generated colors might differ from your custom palette. This helps you decide whether to use:
  • Auto-generated: Dynamic, works with any base color, easier to maintain
  • Custom values: Precise control, brand-specific, requires manual updates
